## What it is

A standard 2 x 6 female PMOD socket with twelve square pin entrances on 2.54 mm pitch.

## Design notes

The part is centered on the origin with its seating face at Z = 0 so assemblies can place repeated instances directly.

## Don't

Do not infer pitch or contact count from scan-softened geometry; they follow the PMOD hardware standard.
